record.title: MEASURE R43 durable run — replication epistemic observability
record.body: Durable learning: qualification-court existence is option capital, not realized epistemic capital. R43 therefore added executable measurements for exact-subject/currentness, receipt/falsifier coverage, independent evidence roots, consumer and qualification fanout, realized dependency relief, replay, generator/source correspondence, compatibility, CI evidence, uncertainty, memory continuity, ERRC, and explicit multiplier proof/shortfall. Project #2 began with zero canonical DfCM records; that absence itself generated memory observability capital. Verification also falsified two construction assumptions: canonical pack ownership must be under packs/, and a guard must not interpret the source code of a detector as the violation it detects. Both became permanent repairs before merge. Exact merge containment: main aaad22568fdb4fee537ce663d4b640585bd5c194 has qualified head 4baf32dd33112236c301906bea2df631e6c188cd as second parent.
